text:
alex_chang: Kicked off eu-west5 cluster bring-up at 06:20UTC, hitting a hard failure during node bootstrap. GPU instances spin up but kubelet never registers. Seeing repeated ENI attach failures and then a rollback from the deploy bot.

priya_patel: Can you paste the kubelet logs or the cloud error? Is this the new AMI?

jamal_roberts: Pasting the last lines from the bootstrap log:```
ERROR: AttachNetworkInterface failed: RequestLimitExceeded: You have exceeded the allowed number of network interfaces for this instance type in this region.
status code: 403, request id: 1234-abc
Caused by: failed to create CNI configuration: no available ENIs
```

marta: Hmm, eu-west5 has lower default ENI quotas for the instance family we chose (a10x -> 8 ENIs max per AZ). We used /26 subnets which left little headroom for node IPs + pods. Could be IP exhaustion + ENI quota bump needed.

infra-deploy-bot: terraform apply: error encountered, rolling back changes. Resources partially created: 3 nodegroups failed to join, autoscaler paused.

alex_chang: We also saw driver mismatches after the failed nodes reattempted: AMI had nvidia-driver 535 but runtime expects 525 -> kubelet containerd crashes on start. Not sure if that happened before or after ENI errors.

priya_patel: Order of ops: if ENIs fail attach, nodes stay NotReady and then bootstrap retries, which can hit driver install steps repeatedly. Two separate issues but both blocking. Quick checklist: subnet size, ENI quota, AMI driver version.

jamal_roberts: For a quick mitigation we can: 1) pause provisioning 2) expand subnet from /26 -> /22 (we have IP space) 3) request ENI quota bump in console (but that takes time) 4) swap to an instance family with higher ENI limits or reduce pods per node via taint.

marta: Cost callout: switching to larger instance family to get more ENIs will increase hourly $ by ~25-40%. If we change subnet instead we avoid that. But requesting quota still needed for long-term.

alex_chang: I'm doing the subnet change now (editing TF vars) and will re-run apply in a dry-run then apply. Dropping the max pods to 60 as a temporary knob.

priya_patel: Also open a ticket with infra-cloud to pre-approve quota increase and log the AMI driver mismatch with images team. We should pin the gpu-driver version in the AMI bake pipeline.

sre_oncall: Taking ownership for coordination. I'll notify cloud support and follow quota ticket. If quota bump is delayed >24h we fallback to AZ mix with smaller instances. Will join the call at 07:00UTC. :phone: :eyes:

jamal_roberts: After subnet expansion, remember to run a rolling restart of the failed nodegroup once kernel modules are stable. Also add a preflight in the runbook: validate ENI quota and AMI driver before apply.

alex_chang: Update: applied subnet /22, re-ran tf plan -> apply. Terraform created new nodegroup but deploy-bot still reported one node failed due to driver. I'm rolling a new AMI with pinned 525 driver and will kick it off to the failing group.

infra-deploy-bot: deploy: new-ami-2026-03-18 queued for nodegroup eu-west5-gpu-pool.

sre_oncall: Good. Please add a line to the runbook about checking "DescribeAccountAttributes / ENI limits" and attaching the quota request template. I'll convert this thread into a short postmortem if we don't hit production later.

alex_chang: Will do. Taking notes for the runbook: preflight checklist (subnet mask, ENI limits, AMI driver, pod density, TF state lock), rollback steps (drain -> terminate nodes, revert AMI, change instance family), and cost implications.

marta: Thanks team. Lessons learned: small subnet + ENI quota = silent buttress for GPU bringups. We'll standardize eu-west5 bootstraps with /22 and pre-create quota requests for the GPU families.

alex_chang: Closing the immediate blocker: nodes healthy after AMI swap and subnet change. Leaving this thread for handoff notes and action items. :white_check_mark:
